NICE_222.title: NICE NG222, Depression in adults
NICE_222.used_for: Validated measures alongside comprehensive assessment and follow-up; not automatic diagnosis or a requirement for every encounter
NICE_222.access: Official indexed recommendation text inspected; direct retrieval intermittently blocked

NICE_197.title: NICE NG197, Shared decision making
NICE_197.used_for: Participation, shared agenda and manageable information; exact invitation wording/placement is project design
NICE_197.access: Previously inspected official recommendation text; same source retained

PHQ9_2001.title: Kroenke, Spitzer & Williams (2001), PHQ-9 validation
PHQ9_2001.locator: J Gen Intern Med 16:606-613; abstract, Methods and Appendix p.613
PHQ9_2001.used_for: Original validation, 0-27 total and conventional symptom-severity bands; independent professional interview comparison
PHQ9_2001.access: Full/indexed original text inspected via official IHS mirror https://www.ihs.gov/sites/crs/themes/responsive2017/display_objects/documents/phq_9.pdf; direct local download timed out

PHQ2_2003.title: Kroenke, Spitzer & Williams (2003), PHQ-2 validation
PHQ2_2003.used_for: Two-item, two-week case finding; 0-6 score and >=3 screening threshold in original study
PHQ2_2003.access: Primary abstract inspected; full article not claimed read

CDC_DPQ.title: CDC NHANES August 2021-August 2023 depression screener documentation
CDC_DPQ.locator: Component Description; Interview Setting; Analytic Notes; codebook
CDC_DPQ.used_for: Two-week item-frequency categories 0-3, complete-item total, separate functional-difficulty question and explicit missing/refused codes; no survey-specific routing imported

UW_PHQ_FORM.title: University of Washington-hosted PHQ-9 form and tally sheet
UW_PHQ_FORM.locator: PDF pp.1-2 form and numeric tally; p.3 arithmetic only
UW_PHQ_FORM.used_for: Verification of item order, response coding and separate function item. Old treatment/diagnostic shortcuts on p.3 are not adopted
UW_PHQ_FORM.access: Public form/indexed PDF inspected; no full questionnaire wording bundled here

APA_ASSESSMENT.title: American Psychological Association, Depression assessment instruments
APA_ASSESSMENT.used_for: Official professional source lists PHQ-9 as free to use; availability does not establish validity of an altered language or mode

WHO5_2024.title: WHO (2024), The World Health Organization-Five Well-Being Index
WHO5_2024.locator: Questionnaire printed p.1 and scoring p.2 / PDF pp.6-7
WHO5_2024.used_for: Five-item two-week well-being measure; 0-25 raw, x4 to 0-100, higher is better; raw <13 suggests further assessment
WHO5_2024.access: Official PDF downloaded; scoring page rendered/visually reviewed. Publication licensed CC-BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO; item wording not bundled

ACOG_SCREEN.title: ACOG, Patient Screening
ACOG_SCREEN.locator: Perinatal screening recommendations and tool resources
ACOG_SCREEN.used_for: Perinatal context uses a standardized validated instrument; PHQ-9 or EPDS can be relevant
ACOG_SCREEN.access: Official indexed page inspected; direct retrieval returned 402

EPDS_1987.title: Cox, Holden & Sagovsky (1987), EPDS development
EPDS_1987.used_for: Original ten-item postnatal screening scale, distinct from PHQ; no universal perinatal superiority claim

EPDS_FORM.title: Black Dog Institute, EPDS form and instructions
EPDS_FORM.used_for: Seven-day recall and item-specific coding; candidate protocol only, not an enabled scorer
EPDS_FORM.access: Institutional form/indexed instructions inspected; permissions/language/version review still required before bundling

GDS_AUTHOR.title: Yesavage, Stanford Geriatric Depression Scale resource
GDS_AUTHOR.locator: Scale purpose, short-form resources, basic references and translation disclaimer; linked English short-form scoring page specifies the past week
GDS_AUTHOR.used_for: Older-adult screening candidate; author states original scale public domain. Translation availability does not mean verified accuracy
GDS_AUTHOR.access: Author-maintained page and linked scoring key inspected; informal missing-item prorating suggestion is not adopted in this prototype

MADRS_1979.title: Montgomery & Asberg (1979), A new depression scale designed to be sensitive to change
MADRS_1979.used_for: Original ten-item depression severity-rating development; not a license or an unrestricted conversation scoring method

SIGMA_2008.title: Williams & Kobak (2008), Development and reliability of a structured interview guide for MADRS (SIGMA)
SIGMA_2008.used_for: Evidence that interview-based clinician rating uses a defined guide and rater process; not permission to let an unvalidated LLM assign scores
SIGMA_2008.access: Original publisher abstract inspected; instrument/manual not obtained. Publisher webpage upload date differs from original 2008 journal issue

ISPMD_2011.title: O’Brien et al. (2011), ISPMD Montreal consensus
ISPMD_2011.used_for: Prospective cycle-wide records for premenstrual pattern assessment
ISPMD_2011.access: Previously inspected original consensus/indexed text; detailed PMDD module retained

DRSP_2006.title: Endicott, Nee & Harrison (2006), DRSP reliability and validity
DRSP_2006.locator: Arch Womens Ment Health 9:41-49; existing PMDD source register
DRSP_2006.used_for: Daily symptom measurement for menstrual-pattern review; not a one-visit PHQ substitute
DRSP_2006.access: Existing PMDD source review reused; item text/scorer not bundled

NIMH_ASQ.title: NIMH, Ask Suicide-Screening Questions toolkit
NIMH_ASQ.locator: Adult materials; using the toolkit; response-plan requirement
NIMH_ASQ.used_for: Dedicated safety screen/pathway is distinct from depression scoring; plan and trained follow-up required

PHQ9_SAFETY_LIMIT.title: Limitations of Screening for Depression as a Proxy for Suicide Risk in Adult Medical Inpatients
PHQ9_SAFETY_LIMIT.used_for: Adult inpatient evidence that a negative depression/item-9 result cannot stand in for dedicated suicide assessment
PHQ9_SAFETY_LIMIT.access: Primary indexed study findings inspected; no universal performance estimate generalized

NICE_225.title: NICE NG225, Self-harm
NICE_225.used_for: No predictive global low/medium/high risk labels or score-only treatment/discharge

CHAT_PHQ_2021.title: Dosovitsky et al. (2021), Psychometric Properties of a Chatbot Version of the PHQ-9 With Adults and Older Adults
CHAT_PHQ_2021.used_for: Feasibility/internal consistency in 3895 respondents; no paper comparator or criterion/construct validation, so not proof of diagnostic equivalence

HOPEBOT_2026.title: Guo et al. (2026), Feasibility and user evaluation of HopeBot
HOPEBOT_2026.locator: Published 25 June 2026; Methods, Results, Study limitations
HOPEBOT_2026.used_for: 132 adults, chatbot vs self-administered PHQ-9 concordance; no clinician diagnostic reference, fixed order/recall and sample limitations; research design context only
